prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated transparent PNG projectile sprite for a 2D side-view fighting game: a single ball of corrosive spit from the Straight-Jacket in Silent Hill: Origins (2007), specifically the Origins attack, not the continuous acid cloud of Silent Hill 2.

Source constraints: the official Origins strategy guide calls this a long-range corrosive spit projectile (printed page 141, PDF page 142); the game walkthrough describes yellow acid balls. The low-resolution gameplay emission has a muted dirty yellow / pale ochre appearance. Depict ONE compact irregular acid glob in flight, moving LEFT to RIGHT, with a wet dense pale yellow-ochre center and a thin hazy yellow-gray fringe. Its rounded leading mass is on the right. A very short tapering broken smear and a few tiny droplets trail immediately left. The compact leading glob must dominate; do not turn it into a continuous spray or a long smoke plume. Organic uneven contour, slightly cloudy and liquid, soft translucency at the perimeter. Keep the color sickly faded yellow and gray-ochre, not neon green, not glowing magic, no white electricity, no fire. Render as a restrained survival-horror visual effect with believable liquid and aerosol texture, readable at small game scale.

Composition: wide horizontal canvas around 2:1, one single compact projectile centered, full silhouette visible with at least 15% genuinely transparent margins all around. No monster, no body, no mouth, no weapon, no environment, no floor or impact puddle. No solid background, no checkerboard baked into image, no card, no text, no logo, no watermark, no border. Real alpha transparency. Do not make a spritesheet or several alternatives. This is an original static interpretation for the versus game, not a claimed extraction of the original game's exact pixels.
